Title: Imibhalo engezantsi yomdlalo
Subtitle: Guqulela izihlokwana zesiNgesi ukusuka kwiPS5 yakho kwiOBS.
ConnectHint: Yongeza iskripthi kwindawo yakho yomdlalo kube kanye.
TestHint: Zama umgca wesampuli phambi kokudibanisa ikhonsoli.
SelectHint: Zoba ibhokisi ejikeleze izihlokwana zesiNgesi kwisakhelo somdlalo.
AreaReady: Indawo yombhalo ongezantsi igciniwe. Layita ikhamera ye-OBS ebonakalayo.
Help: Khetha indawo yakho yomdlalo kwi-OBS. Vula iZixhobo → Izikripthi kwaye ucofe +. Ncamathisela indlela yokubhala kwaye uvule ifayile. Cofa iqhosha kwizicwangciso zescript ukongeza izihlokwana kwindawo. Buyela kwi-SubZir kwaye uguqule uguqulelo.
Checking: Ukufunda umgca wesampulu kwaye ujonga uqhagamshelo lwe-OBS…
TestSuccess: I-OBS ifumene umgca wesampulu. Jonga indawo yayo kwindawo.
TestNoAck: Inguqulelo iphumelele, kodwa i-OBS ayizange iqinisekise. Khetha indawo yakho yomdlalo kwaye uphinda inyathelo loku-1.
Waiting: Ilinde imibhalo engezantsi yesiNgesi kwikhamera ye-OBS...
OcrMissing: Faka ukuqondwa kombhalo wesiNgesi kwiWindows. Jonga isikhokelo ngemiyalelo.
CheckCamera: Jonga ikhamera yenyani kwaye ukhethe indawo yemibhalo engezantsi kwakhona.
TestFailed: Uvavanyo alukwazanga ukugqiba. Vula ukuJonga ingxaki kwisikhokelo.
TestEmpty: Akukho mgca wesampula ufunyenweyo. Zama uvavanyo kwakhona.
NoFrame: Akukho sakhelo sifunyenweyo. Kwi-OBS, qala ikhamera ebonakalayo kwaye uphinda inyathelo lesi-3.
LaunchError: Khupha yonke i-ZIP kuMqulu uze uzame kwakhona.
Picker: Zoba ibhokisi ejikeleze indawo yomgca omnye okanye emibini yezihlokwana
GuideBody: Nika amandla imibhalo engezantsi yesiNgesi kumdlalo wakho. Qhagamshela ikhadi lokubamba kwi-OBS. Yongeza umbhalo ongezantsi kwindawo yomdlalo. Seta imveliso yekhamera ebonakalayo kumthombo wekhadi lokubanjwa kwaye uqalise ikhamera ebonakalayo. Kwi-SubZir, khetha indawo yemibhalo engezantsi kwaye uqalise ukuguqulela.
ModelError: Imodeli yoguqulo ayikwazanga ukugqiba isicelo. Jonga ixesha lokusebenza/diagnostics.txt.
